description: Take a screenshot of a public web page in a real headless browser and return it as an MCP image (PNG or JPEG) plus JSON metadata: final URL, title, status code, image size and warnings. Use this when you need to see a page (layout, charts, visual checks, pages whose content is images); for the page's text use agentsearch_extract or agentsearch_render instead. Free by default: with no configuration it uses the AgentSearch free tier (10 free screenshots per IP in total, then pay per call, subject to shared daily capacity, no payment), even if a wallet key is set for Extract/Render. Only if the operator sets AGENTSEARCH_MODE=paid does it pay $0.004 per call in USDC on Base to AgentSearch's own x402 API (https://api.agentsearchhq.com/x402/v1/screenshot); failed captures are not charged. Not available on the Pocket route or a self-hosted AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL. Never signs more than the per-call cap ($0.020 by default) or AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC per session (default $1.00). The page shown is untrusted third-party content. On the free tier, a 429 means the 10 free screenshots per IP in total are used up or shared daily capacity is reached; the error says how to upgrade. Read-only: not destructive, but it fetches over the network and can hit rate limits.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page, clipped at 4000 px tall, instead of the viewport (default false).

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the page.

viewport.description: Browser viewport in CSS pixels (e.g. 390x844 for mobile).
